content:
Floris van Doorn and I are organising a one-week workshop on advancing mathlib in Bonn, April 26 to 30, 2027. During this workshop, we will focus on advancing Mathlib, Lean's curated integrated library of formalized mathematics. Most of the time is reserved for working in small groups, on new or pre-existing projects adding to Mathlib. There will be time to discuss cross-cutting concerns, a social event and time to connect as a community. Participants are expected to have prior experience in contributing to Mathlib.

The event will take place at the Hausdorff Institute in Bonn, nicely located in the centre of Bonn.

Applications are open until December 18. Our webpage includes further information and instructions for how to apply. We can cover accommodation, but travel costs only in some cases (e.g., PhD students or via the Global Mobility Fellowships).
